scope: Synthetic historical corpus followed by actual next/submit preparation, draft, facts, reader and commit. Reports cumulative protocol characters, without external models, billed tokens or literary quality claims.

protocol_usage.boundary: 字符仅观测，不限制必要内容；输入按持久任务计一次；不含系统提示、聊天历史和协议外读取，不换算token。

cases.note: Engineering synthetic decisions only; hooks case retains future long-term promises approaching a common deadline, not overdue debt or a completed novel.
